title: The Power of God Will Win Them Over
description: In this powerful sermon, Pastor Chris Zehner reveals how encountering the power of God can transform your life forever. With raw honesty and enthusiasm, he shares his own testimony of how the power of God broke him free from addiction and set him ablaze for ministry. Join Pastor Chris as he explores what it means to be a "proof producer" and how you can be used by God to demonstrate His power in the lives of others.
